title: Murder on Mumbai local: GRP recover knife used in stabbing; how viral video led them to it
summary: Police have recovered the knife allegedly used in a fatal stabbing of a man on a Mumbai local train, thanks to a viral video and a restaurant manager. The accused, Roshan Suvarna, claimed he'd carried the weapon for months and discarded it after the incident.
